kswe01.title: Aries Woke Up Patient
kswe01.caption:
Aries woke up as a Taurus and did the unthinkable: put the phone face down and made soup.
Two hours, zero follow-up texts. Who in your life needs this swap?

kswe02.title: Taurus Woke Up Spontaneous
kswe02.caption:
A text at 10:47 PM: wanna go out right now? Taurus, in a Sagittarius body, was already out the door in slippers.
What time is too late for a yes?

kswe03.title: Gemini Woke Up With a Plan
kswe03.caption:
One hour of where are we eating. Then Gemini woke up a Capricorn and booked the noodle place in one message.
Tag the friend who finally decides.

kswe04.title: Cancer Woke Up Chill
kswe04.caption:
The ex texted hey stranger and Cancer, briefly an Aquarius, replied kindly and archived it in one breath. Then the swap wore off.
Feelings: fully back, and honestly welcome.

kswe05.title: Leo Woke Up Listening
kswe05.caption:
Leo woke up a Virgo and spent a whole first date asking questions. Remembered the cat's name and everything.
Inner Leo is still screaming about the hair.

kswe06.title: Virgo Woke Up Feeling Everything
kswe06.caption:
Virgo woke up a Pisces and cried at a dog, a sunset and one text that said you look nice.
The fix was labelled jars. The jars did not help.

kswe07.title: Libra Woke Up Decisive
kswe07.caption:
Libra woke up an Aries: ordered in one second, then texted the crush first. Then stared at the phone for four very long seconds.
Would you send first?

kswe08.title: Scorpio Woke Up Chatty
kswe08.caption:
Scorpio woke up a Gemini on a first date and told them everything. The goldfish named Kevin. The giraffe dream.
Plot twist: they had the same dream.

kswe09.title: Sagittarius Woke Up Sentimental
kswe09.caption:
Trip day, and Sag woke up a Cancer. Could not leave the plant, the mug or the friend. Then sent the text it usually skips: i'll miss you.
Who do you miss before you even leave?

kswe10.title: Capricorn Woke Up Glowing
kswe10.caption:
Capricorn woke up a Leo and swapped the grumpy profile photo for the smiling one.
The ring light was a lot. The glow-up was real.

kswe11.title: Aquarius Woke Up Reading Into It
kswe11.caption:
They texted lol. Aquarius, now a Scorpio, built a whole red-string board about it by 2:14 AM.
They were typing on the bus. Be honest: how long would your board be?

kswe12.title: Pisces Woke Up Balanced
kswe12.caption:
Pisces woke up a Libra and stayed perfectly calm at the wedding. The cake, the bouquet, table 9.
Then the vows started. Balance lasted four minutes.

kswe13.title: The Roommate Swap
kswe13.caption:
Aries and Cancer swapped on date night. One showed up 40 minutes early; one cried at a lasagne from mum.
Both texted the same thing at 7:02. Tag your roommate.

kswe14.title: Swapped With the Date
kswe14.caption:
Leo and Aquarius swapped on their first date. Suddenly Leo wanted to talk about space and Aquarius wanted a photo of them.
The fastest way to get someone: be them for a minute.

kswe15.title: Everyone Swapped
kswe15.caption:
Midnight, and all twelve signs woke up in the wrong body. Virgo's room is a campsite. Scorpio said hehe out loud.
Pisces is still crying. Which swap would wreck your group chat?
